# opnsense_interfaces_gre (Data Source)

GRE tunnel devices (**Interfaces ▸ Devices ▸ GRE**). OPNsense names the device (`greN`) and configures the inner addresses; assign the device to filter its traffic per interface.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the GRE tunnel.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `device` (String) Device name, e.g. `gre0`. Assigned by OPNsense when unset.
- `local_address` (String) Local outer address: an interface name such as `wan`, a CARP VIP (`wan_vip1`), an IP alias or an IP address.
- `remote_address` (String) Remote outer address.
- `tunnel_local_address` (String) Local inner address of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_remote_address` (String) Remote inner address of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_remote_net` (Number) Prefix length of the inner remote address.
